subject: Why does the mapping variable exist ?

messages.author: 318aadb0c9e6b679
messages.subject: Why does the mapping variable exist ?
parts:
As far as I can tell, the only value the 'mapping' argument can take is 'aes'.  Can someone point me to a an example in which mapping takes a different value?  If not, what is the point of this variable ?  This is an 'enquiring minds want to know' kind of question.  In other words why couldn't one just have something like 'geom_obj(aes=***) .  Thanks.

Adam
